# DOT Hazmat Function Specific Training: The Hazmat Table

> 2-hour online function-specific training on the DOT Hazardous Materials Table, 49 CFR 172.101 (49 CFR Part 172 Subpart B). Available in English and Spanish. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Duration: 2 hours; 2 modules, 3 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 0.2 CEU
- Price: $39.99 per person; bulk pricing available
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7, audio option; SCORM, virtual instructor-led and on-site formats also available
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Prerequisites: none
- Certificate: downloadable on passing; valid 3 years (recurrent training at least every three years, and when relevant regulations change)

## Hazardous Materials Table columns
1. Symbols
2. Hazardous materials descriptions and proper shipping names
3. Hazard class or division
4. Identification number
5. Packing group
6. Label codes
7. Special provisions
8. Packaging (exceptions, non-bulk, bulk)
9. Quantity limitations (passenger aircraft or rail; cargo aircraft only)
10. Vessel stowage
- Appendix A: hazardous substances and reportable quantities
- Appendix B: marine pollutants

## Lessons
1. Regulatory Overview
2. Hazardous Materials Table, Part 1
3. Hazardous Materials Table, Part 2

## Who should take it
Workers who classify materials; staff responsible for packaging, labeling and documentation; hazmat employees who ship, handle or transport hazmat; logistics professionals; hazmat employers and safety managers.
